data.gender_notes: Debnath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Debnath is the deity who frees us from our debts, both material and spiritual. He is a form of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation. The name Debnath carries the meaning “God of Debts” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Debnath usually hope their child will grow to embody god of debts and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes release from bondage and the attainment of spiritual freedom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Debnath total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
